Would you like to work in one of the most advanced high-tech environments in the world? Do you have experience in logistics and enjoy working with precision, quality, and technology? If you are a logistics professional willing to work in 2 shift, please read on and apply! For our client ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for motivated Warehouse & Cleanroom Operators to support the logistics processes behind the production of cutting-edge semiconductor equipment. This is your opportunity to join a world-leading technology company where innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for candidates who have: MBO Level 3 or 4 education in Logistics or a comparable qualification Affinity with logistics processes and technology At least 2 years of experience in logistics and/or a production environment Experience in a cleanroom environment (preferred) Experience working with quality standards (preferred) Good command of the English language, both spoken and written Basic to intermediate computer skills Experience with SAP is considered an advantage A flexible attitude towards future shift schedule changes In addition, candidates must be able to provide: A valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) An EPT certificate A Hoisting & Lifting certificate (training is provided) Wat bieden wij je? We offer an exciting opportunity to grow within a leading high-tech environment where your contribution matters: Gross monthly salary of €3,195 (excluding shift allowance) 25.1% shift allowance for working in a two-shift schedule Working hours: 06:30–15:30 and 15:00–00:00 Travel reimbursement 13th month salary Annual bonus based on company results Long-term career and development opportunities Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse & Cleanroom Operator, you play a vital role in ensuring materials, tools, and components are available at the right place and at the right time. You will work in both warehouse and cleanroom

environments and contribute directly to the efficiency of ASML's production processes. Your responsibilities will include: Issuing and receiving materials, tools, parts, and packaging for internal customers Transporting materials to and from cleanroom cabins Checking materials for quality, completeness, and accuracy Cleaning, packaging, and preparing materials for storage and transportation Picking and preparing orders for internal and external customers Processing logistics data in administrative systems Loading and unloading trucks using an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
